title: Winter Solstice: Why Winter Nights Are the Longest of the Year!

lines.text: Star light, star bright, first star I see tonight!
lines.caps: Star light, star *BRIGHT, | first star I *SEE | *TONIGHT!

lines.text: Today is the Winter Solstice—the shortest day and longest night of the whole year!
lines.caps: Today is the Winter *SOLSTICE— | the shortest day and longest *NIGHT | of the *WHOLE | *YEAR!

lines.text: But did the sun take a nap? No, it's all about Earth's secret tilt!
lines.caps: But did the sun take a *NAP? | No, it's all about *EARTH'S | secret *TILT!

lines.text: Planet Earth spins tilted like a spinning top at twenty-three degrees!
lines.caps: Planet Earth spins *TILTED | like a spinning top at *TWENTY-THREE | *DEGREES!

lines.text: In December, the top half of Earth leans furthest away from the sun's warm rays!
lines.caps: In December, the top *HALF | of Earth leans furthest *AWAY | from the sun's warm *RAYS!

lines.text: Because of that tilt, the sun takes a very low, quick shortcut across the winter sky!
lines.caps: Because of that *TILT, | the sun takes a very *LOW, | quick shortcut across the winter *SKY!

lines.text: Less daytime sunlight means long, cozy nights for stargazing and dreaming!
lines.caps: Less daytime *SUNLIGHT | means long, cozy *NIGHTS | for stargazing and *DREAMING!

lines.text: And starting tomorrow, the days start getting brighter and longer again!
lines.caps: And starting *TOMORROW, | the days start getting *BRIGHTER | and longer *AGAIN!

lines.text: Celebrate the solstice with us and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: *CELEBRATE the solstice | with us and *SUBSCRIBE | to *BABYBEATS | *RHYMO!
